faq: Do you set my prices for me?
We recommend them with the reasoning, and apply the changes only after you approve. Prices are your decision, because you know your market, your time and what your buyers expect.
Which costs do I need to provide?
Material costs, packaging, how long an item takes, and shipping cost. If you do not know some, we use a short worksheet to estimate them, and mark each estimate clearly.
Can you run Etsy sales and coupons?
Yes. We schedule Etsy sales and coupon codes in your shop using the tools Etsy provides, with start and end dates. We never use fake original prices or invented discounts.
Will lower prices raise my orders?
Not always. We aim for a price that sells and still pays you fairly. Sometimes the answer is a higher price, a bundle or a better photo, and we explain which one fits.
desc:
Etsy pricing review and sale events start with knowing what each item really earns after fees. Ecom Swift LLC counts your costs, shows your true margin and plans sales and coupons in your Etsy shop that still leave you a profit.

## What is an Etsy pricing review?

An Etsy pricing review is a line-by-line calculation of what each product costs you and what is left after Etsy takes its share. It adds materials, your time, packaging, shipping, listing fees, transaction fees and payment processing, then compares the total with the price a buyer pays.

Ecom Swift LLC builds this view for your items and turns it into a reusable sheet. From it we suggest price changes and plan sale offers that you can afford.

## Why sellers lose money without noticing

Prices are often set by feel, by copying a competitor or by remembering what a similar item sold for. The seller sees money arrive and assumes it is profit. Then the fees, the free shipping that was offered, the materials and the hours are taken out, and little or nothing remains.

Discounts make this worse. A sale offered on an item with a thin margin can turn a small profit into a loss, and many sales only bring in buyers who would have paid full price.

## How pricing and sales affect your results

A good price has to do two jobs. It must look fair to the buyer, and it must leave you enough to keep making the item. When you know your true margin, you can see which items can bear a higher price, which are priced about right and which lose money.

Sales and coupons work through urgency and reward. A limited offer can bring back visitors who hesitated, and a coupon for past buyers can bring repeat orders. They only help when the discount fits inside your margin. Lower prices do not automatically raise orders, since buyers also weigh photos, reviews and shipping, so we plan offers around your numbers rather than guesses.

## What a good pricing review includes

- A cost list per item: materials, time, packaging and supplies.
- Etsy listing, transaction and payment processing fees counted in.
- Shipping costs compared with what the buyer is charged.
- A true margin shown for every item reviewed.
- A short list of items to raise, keep or rework.
- A sale or coupon plan with a floor price you will not go below.
- Dates and settings for the offer in your Etsy shop.
- A reusable sheet for pricing future products.
- Bundle and set ideas, and a seasonal calendar, in the higher package.

## What we do

You give us the cost of materials, the time each item takes and your shipping costs. We pull your prices and fee details from your shop and build the cost sheet. Each item gets a margin figure, and we mark where a change would help.

We then design an offer. In the Standard package, that means one sale or coupon plan, scheduled inside your shop once you approve. Premium adds more items, three planned events, bundle ideas and a calendar for the year. You decide every final price. We advise, and we change nothing without your approval.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Count your own time as a cost.
- Include shipping and packaging in every calculation.
- Set a minimum price for sales and stick to it.
- Run a sale for a clear reason, such as a season or a launch.
- Review prices again when material costs change.

**Avoid:**
- Matching a competitor's price without knowing their costs.
- Offering free shipping without checking the margin.
- Discounting your best sellers by default.
- Running sales all the time, which trains buyers to wait.
- Forgetting the fee on shipping and gift wrap charges.

## Who this service is for

It suits a seller who is busy and not sure whether the shop earns anything. It helps someone planning a holiday sale who wants it to pay, and a maker adding a new product who needs a confident starting price.

## What we need from you

Send a list of items, your material and packaging costs, the time each takes and your usual shipping method. Access to your shop as a manager with limited permissions helps us read fee and price details, but passwords are never needed. We confirm each change with you first.
